note: Provisional values chosen by the project owner. The load is configured in load_config (configured, not measured); its dimensions are to be measured later in Unity.
speed_note: Added 2026-10-15 after the Step 9 replay demo (design decision, not tuning): inputs of the decision look-ahead (decision.json -> look_ahead).
body_drive_note: Added 2026-10-19 for Step 1 (Unity robot): robot_length_m, robot_height_m (top of the body above the ground, mast excluded), max_accel_mps2, max_angular_speed_radps, max_angular_accel_radps2. Provisional simulation values, not measured, not tuned. Unity reads this file (Assets/WarehouseRobot/Robot/Config/robot_unity.json -> paths): the box is robot_width_m x robot_length_m x robot_height_m, and the differential drive is limited by max_speed_mps, max_accel_mps2, decel_mps2 (braking, the same value the look-ahead uses), max_angular_speed_radps and max_angular_accel_radps2.
estop_note: Added 2026-10-20 (design decision by the project owner, not tuning): estop_decel_mps2 is used only while the emergency stop is latched (Unity DiffDriveController). Normal braking, and the look-ahead calculation, use decel_mps2.
required_passage_width_rule: (furthest right - furthest left extent of robot and load from the robot centre line) + 2 * safety_margin_per_side_m; computed only by footprint.required_width / footprint.load_footprint
